description: Owner-selected local global-memory read/write/readwrite microbenchmarks with ordinary device malloc and complete exact CPU verification. Historical SHOC identifier; not the full upstream SHOC DeviceMemory suite.

scaling_param.name: array_size_mb
scaling_param.description: Array size in binary MiB (2^20 bytes); historical parameter name retained.

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.
